defect: the read-side FIFO receiver has no reset while the write-side sender can reset
rationale: rst_wr_ni can reset write_toggle_q independently, but data_o and read_toggle_q have no reset in the receiving clock domain and can retain invalid state.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the FIFO to a write toggle, a synchronized read-side observation, and the receiving data register.

mutation.description: Removed the read-domain reset from data_o and read_toggle_q while retaining an independently reset sender.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: read_toggle_q has no reset while the sender toggle is reset, so the toggle compare starts from X and can emit a spurious transfer.
